# Charbel Mdawar — Software Engineer

> Professional portfolio of Charbel Mdawar (شربل مدور), a software engineer based in Damascus, Syria, specializing in backend development and quality assurance.

The website is available in English by default, with an Arabic language switch. Both languages describe the same experience and projects. The downloadable CV is a PDF.

Charbel works with Java, Spring Boot, Laravel, secure APIs, identity and payment integrations, real-time systems, and software testing. His experience includes QA Manager at IXCoders, Java Spring Developer / Team Lead and Laravel Developer at Prokoders, and Quality Assurance Specialist at ecmarkt.com.

Projects include CallX (a multi-tenant call center platform in development), Brag CRM, CryptoX, and quality assurance work on Al-Ahlam ERP & Manufacturing, Salaza ERP / CRM / HR, El-Salleh E-Commerce, GoPal, and Smo Al Mosafer. Project descriptions distinguish development work from validation and testing. External company links describe the organizations; they are not source-code repositories.

## Portfolio and CV

- [Portfolio](https://charbelmdawar.com/): Professional overview, expertise, experience, projects, education, and contact details.
- [PDF CV](https://charbelmdawar.com/Charbel_Mdawar.pdf): Downloadable curriculum vitae.
- [Projects](https://charbelmdawar.com/#work): Eight projects with descriptions, contributions, and relevant technologies.
- [Experience](https://charbelmdawar.com/#experience): Employment history and responsibilities.
- [Contact](https://charbelmdawar.com/#contact): Public professional contact information.

## Optional

- [Salaza Group](https://salazagroup.com/): Salon group operating across Syria, the UAE, and Iraq.
- [El-Salleh](https://el-salleh.com/): Shopping and delivery platform in Syria.
- [GoPal](https://gopalsa.com/): Children's activity discovery and booking platform in Saudi Arabia.
